definitions.explanation: An automated gate at train and subway stations that reads tickets or IC cards to allow passengers through. A ubiquitous feature of Japanese public transportation.

examples.japanese: {自動改札|じどうかいさつ}を{通|とお}る。
examples.english: I pass through the ticket gate.

examples.japanese: ICカードを{自動改札|じどうかいさつ}にタッチした。
examples.english: I tapped my IC card on the automatic ticket gate.

examples.japanese: {切符|きっぷ}が{自動改札|じどうかいさつ}に{引|ひ}っかかってしまい、{駅員|えきいん}を{呼|よ}んだ。
examples.english: My ticket got stuck in the automatic gate, so I called a station attendant.

notes:
{自動改札|じどうかいさつ} is the automatic ticket gate found at train and subway stations. Composed of {自動|じどう} (automatic) + {改札|かいさつ} (ticket inspection/gate).

FULL FORM:
The official name is {自動改札機|じどうかいさつき} (automatic ticket gate machine), but {自動改札|じどうかいさつ} is the standard short form.

HOW IT WORKS:
- Insert a paper ticket into the slot, or tap an IC card on the reader
- The gate opens if the fare is valid
- IC cards (Suica, PASMO, ICOCA, etc.) are now the most common method

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自動改札|じどうかいさつ}を{通|とお}る: to pass through the ticket gate
- {自動改札|じどうかいさつ}にタッチする: to tap on the gate
- {自動改札|じどうかいさつ}に{引|ひ}っかかる: to get caught/stuck at the gate

RELATED WORDS:
- {改札口|かいさつぐち}: ticket gate area/entrance
- {有人改札|ゆうじんかいさつ}: staffed ticket gate (for special cases)
